label: FastH3 8-Step V2 T2V+A (distilled)
semantics: Distilled checkpoint with trained VSA sparsity -- a lossy class under this benchmark's policy, compared as its own case because every framework serves the SAME checkpoint under the contract it declares in fastvideo_inference.json: eight DiT forwards on the rungs [999, 874, 749, 624, 500, 375, 250, 125], video/audio shift 10/3, guidance 1, 80% VSA sparsity at 64-token tiles. Not part of the lossless headline. This is the few-step, four-GPU regime where per-request fixed cost (text encode, VAE decode, MP4 encode) is a large share of latency, which the 50-step two-GPU H3 case cannot show.
prompt: At night, while their owner sleeps in a bedroom, three cats march in loudly playing tiny brass instruments, then abruptly file out.
_note: num_inference_steps counts model evaluations (8), as vLLM-Omni does, and so does sglang since its native FastH3 V2 support (#37662: a request with 9 is rejected with 'distilled for exactly eight inference steps (nine sigma grid points, eight DiT forwards)'), so its request carries 8 -- the same eight forwards. Both engines reject any other step count or shift for this checkpoint. Both engines pin revision 71a17d72c58c (2026-09-15 14:57): the next and current revision 3da2ddfe (15:05) removed provenance.json, which vLLM-Omni's V2 loader (#7610, merged 09-17) reads to find the base-H3 VAEs, so the current revision fails there with FileNotFoundError. The weights are identical across the two revisions. guidance_scale goes to vLLM-Omni only (its recipe sends guidance_scale=1); sglang's MiniMaxH3SamplingParams fixes it at 1.0 and rejects the field in a request (400). FastVideo counts sigma grid points (its docs: `--steps` 9 is nine points and eight forwards, and its denoiser rejects any other count for this checkpoint), so its request carries 9 too; it reads the rung ladder from fastvideo_inference.json and the 10/3 shifts from the scheduler configs, both present at 71a17d72. vLLM-Omni requests carry extra_params.preencode_mp4=true (2026-10-08): its documented, off-by-default overlap of MP4 encoding with the VAE decode (byte-identical frames), the counterpart of sglang's default streamed encode (#41819). Both engines run their best documented output path.

default.notes: The recipe's command minus host/port/served-model-name. It says not to pass --fastvideo-vsa-topk (the tile count is derived per request from the trained 80% policy). T2VA is served by the FL2VA partition. Validated 2026-09-30 on 4xH200: 12.06 s client median. The `vsa` extra's fastvideo-kernel 0.3.4 fails on H200 inside the request ('Error in tile TMA descriptor creation', then 'CUDA error: an illegal instruction was encountered'); 0.3.5 works, but its wheel declares torch==2.12.0, so a normal install downgrades vLLM 0.30's torch 2.13.0 and the server dies at startup with 'operator torchvision::nms does not exist'. Install it with --no-deps (scripts/install_comparison_frameworks.sh, VLLM_OMNI_VSA_KERNEL_SPEC). 4xGB300: 8.261/8.254 s; with extra_params.preencode_mp4 (its overlapped encode, off by default) 7.484/7.379 s. The V2 release's bundled vae/ and audio_vae/ are tensor-for-tensor the base-H3@9bfb6693 VAEs this loader fetches, so both engines decode with the same weights.

cand-cudnn-vsa.notes: Derived from `default` (the profile B300 selects). Audit 2026-10-23 (H3 finding 4): the PyPI fastvideo-kernel 0.3.5 has no sm_103a build (block_sparse_attn_sm100a.is_supported requires capability (10, 0)), so on B300 VSA falls to the Triton kernel and runs slower (0.83 s/step) than vLLM-Omni's own dense 4-GPU step (0.73). The recipe (recipes/FastVideo/FastH3-V2.md, fasth3-8step-8gpu.yaml) selects fastvideo_vsa_provider cudnn, which needs the [cudnn-bsa] extra (nvidia-cudnn-frontend==1.31.0 at 0da1d831; require_cudnn_sparse accepts SM90-SM120): install it with VLLM_OMNI_CUDNN_FRONTEND_SPEC=nvidia-cudnn-frontend==1.31.0 (scripts/install_comparison_frameworks.sh). The 2026-10-22 cudnn-vsa-candidate (recipe placement with HSDP + enforce-eager) hung in the first request; this keeps the selected placement and changes only the provider, plus --no-diffusion-compile-dynamic like every other Blackwell vLLM-Omni profile. --diffusion-attention-backend and --diffusion-attention-config.default.backend are mutually exclusive, so the backend moves into the config. VALIDATION PENDING (wave 4, 4xB300).

lightx2v.reason: Checked 2026-10-08 against LightX2V main 0c2edc12 (2026-10-05): LightX2V cannot serve this checkpoint under its trained contract (fastvideo_inference.json). V2 is trained for VIDEO_SPARSE_ATTN_H3 at 0.8 sparsity on 64-token tiles, and LightX2V has no VSA backend (its sparse attentions -- Sparge, SVG, radial, NBHD, Sol-Attn, sparse Sage/FA4 -- are other methods; dense attention would run a different model). Its H3 scheduler builds only a uniform shifted grid from infer_steps, so the explicit rungs [999, 874, ..., 125] cannot be given (an 8-step grid starts at 1000). LightX2V's own few-step H3 paths (configs/minimax_h3/dmd/: 4- and 8-step LoRAs on the base checkpoint, mostly FP8/INT8) are a different distillation, not this checkpoint, and are not substituted.
